subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ200P across its F-Pace X761, XE X760 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ200P is fitted across the F-Pace and XE model lines, in both 250 and 300 horsepower configurations.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain components, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild. Turbocharger and fuel injection components are inspected and measured.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported catastrophic issue pattern has been confirmed for the AJ200P petrol. The engine is generally considered reliable, though timing chain issues have been reported on some Ingenium petrol applications.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ200P rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ200P REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine - illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ200P is the petrol version of the 2.0-litre Ingenium engine, introduced a year after the diesel AJ200D. As with other Ingenium petrol engines, timing chain components are inspected thoroughly during every rebuild.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain components, bearings, gaskets, turbocharger inspection

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
